cpus.name: Intel Core Ultra 200S (Arrow Lake: 285K / 265K / 245K)
cpus.notes: No Hyper-Threading; pinning background apps to E-cores preserves Lion Cove IPC for games & compilers.

cpus.name: Intel 12th–14th Gen Hybrid (12900K / 13900K / 14900K / 14700K)
cpus.notes: Ideal for Intel APO-style isolation: keep foreground tasks on P-cores (lower IDs) and background updaters/AI on E-cores.

cpus.name: AMD Ryzen Dual-CCD X3D (9950X3D / 9900X3D / 7950X3D / 7900X3D)
cpus.notes: Pin latency-sensitive games to CCD0 (first half of logical CPUs) and push background/AI helpers to CCD1.

cpus.name: AMD Ryzen Single-CCD / Dual-V-Cache (9800X3D / 9950X3D2 / 9700X / 7800X3D)
cpus.notes: Unified L3 cache across cores; prioritize CPU nice + I/O throttling without restricting core count.

cpus.name: Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 / Pro / Max / Ultra)
cpus.notes: Unified memory is shared with GPU; hibernating idle AI models frees both RAM and GPU VRAM.

cpus.name: Mobile / Ultrabook CPU (Laptop Battery Focus)
cpus.notes: Caps background polling & pushes dormant helpers down to prevent fan spin and battery drain.

gpus.name: NVIDIA RTX 5090 (32GB GDDR7) / RTX 4090 (24GB GDDR6X)
gpus.notes: Enormous VRAM headroom; safe to keep moderate GPU caches while unloading idle local LLMs before 4K/3D.

gpus.name: NVIDIA RTX 5080 / 5070 Ti / 4080 / 4070 (12–16GB)
gpus.notes: Recommend hibernating Ollama/LM Studio models before launching 4K games or Blender GPU renders.

gpus.name: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16GB) / RX 7900 XTX (24GB) / RX 7800 XT
gpus.notes: Strong raster/VRAM; keep shader cache intact during Gaming mode unless corrupted.

gpus.name: Intel Arc B580 (12GB) / A770 (16GB) / Entry RTX 4060 (8GB)
gpus.notes: Tighter 8–12GB VRAM budget: aggressively unload idle AI chatbots & browser hardware acceleration during games.

gpus.name: Integrated Graphics (Intel Iris/Arc iGPU, AMD Radeon iGPU)
gpus.notes: Shares system RAM as VRAM; freeing idle background RAM directly boosts graphics headroom.

storage.name: NVMe PCIe Gen4 / Gen5 SSD
storage.notes: High IOPS; keep background updaters on Idle I/O priority and preserve >=10% free space for SLC cache.

storage.name: SATA 2.5" / M.2 SSD
storage.notes: Keep >=12% free space and throttle heavy background downloads during active work.

storage.name: Mechanical Hard Drive (HDD 5400/7200 RPM)
storage.notes: High seek latency; strictly isolate background indexing/updates to Idle I/O priority.
